name: ATC-Trainer
tagline: An air-traffic-control game where you direct aircraft by voice and AI pilots answer.
problem: Aviation careers have high costs to entry; radio practice is hard to get.
solution: A Godot simulation of an airport where the player issues official voice commands from gate to takeoff and landing, with AI-generated pilot replies.
demo_moment: Team-described: clear a plane for takeoff by voice.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 112 submissions.
Free practice for an expensive skill.

lessons: Voice AI fits simulations of jobs done by voice.
